    • substituteVar

      public static Expr substituteVar(Expr expr, String varName, String atomName)
      Recursively replaces a predicate variable with a concrete predicate in an immutable Expr tree.
      Parameters:
      expr - the expression to transform
      varName - predicate variable name, such as ?REL
      atomName - replacement predicate, such as abstractCounterpart
      Returns:
      the transformed expression

    • getPredVarArity

      private static int getPredVarArity(String varName, Expr expr)
      Walk the Expr tree to find where varName appears as the head of an SExpr. Returns 0 if found with a RowVar argument (variable arity → accept any relation arity). Returns the arg count if found with only regular args. Returns -1 if not found in this subtree (caller treats as 0 = accept any).
